4417-4695-8089.description:
Activate Hex Parasite by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1742-2034-5003-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
1742-2034-5003-7848.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Repeat step one additional time.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
1742-2034-5003-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card.

2457-4068-4289-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2457-4068-4289-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1563-5223-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-5223-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-5223-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

4476-5641-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4476-5641-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with seven or more loyalty counters

4356-6636-6702.easyPrerequisites: You have not flipped any coins this turn.
4356-6636-6702.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to tap Kilo each turn.
4356-6636-6702.description:
Activate Ral Zarek's third loyalty ability by removing seven loyalty counters from it, causing you to flip five coins, which will all be heads due to Edgar, and causing you to take five extra turns after this one.
Tap Kilo by any method, triggering its ability, putting a loyalty counter on Ral Zarek.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Ral Zarek's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, tapping a permanent and untapping a permanent.
Tap Kilo by any method, triggering its ability, putting a loyalty counter on Ral Zarek.
Repeat from step 4 during your second and third extra turns, and repeat step 5 during your fourth extra turn.
Repeat from step 1 during your fifth extra turns.
4356-6636-6702.notes: You can attack with Kilo to tap it if it'll survive each combat.

2893-3470-4500-5478.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Retreat to Kazandu trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Wylie Duke with "Kraken" chosen

1238-2292-2351-5467-7040.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

1976-2034-3693-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

874-2854-4311-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
874-2854-4311-4574.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2854-4311-4574.description:
Cast Delif's Cone either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Delif's Cone from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

101-957-1987-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
101-957-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat.

2034-3372-4068-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
2034-3372-4068-6006.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2034-3372-4068-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

877-2034-3249.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard that can be cast by paying no more than {1} or {C} due to Morophon.
877-2034-3249.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the creature from your graveyard by paying no more than {1} or {C} due to Morophon.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature cast in step 2, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
If the creature does not require mana to cast due to Morophon, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

618-4299-5200-5313.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control at least five additional creatures.
618-4299-5200-5313.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Dwarven Priest with haste.
The token enters gaining you at least 9 life.
Pay 9 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}.
Pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

3557-4364.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Brago and Aurelia.
3557-4364.description:
Declare Brago and Aurelia as attackers, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill them.
Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this phase.
Deal combat damage with Brago and Aurelia.
Brago triggers, blinking Aurelia.
Repeat each combat phase.

2024-4858-5168.notablePrerequisites: Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
2024-4858-5168.description:
Cast Prismwake Merrow by paying {2}{U}.
Prismwake Merrow enters the battlefield, triggering itself, making a permanent you control all colors until end of turn.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{W}{G}, giving Bloom Tender +3/+3 until end of turn and untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.

2556-3632-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying {4}{U}.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Mnemonic Wall from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
